high-latency.why: Request rate rose ~2.5x, CPU saturated, and the autoscaler is already at its replica ceiling. No deploy, no memory growth.

error-spike-after-deploy.why: 5xx rate went from ~0.3% to ~11% one minute after v3.8.0 rolled out; the errors are a KeyError in code paths touched by that release.

memory-leak.why: Heap usage climbed steadily for four hours with a cache that never evicts, ending in OutOfMemoryError. A restart is the runbook mitigation.

intermittent-5xx.why: Error bursts coincide with both inventory-api 503s and orders-db pool timeouts, shortly after a feature-flag change. No single cause, and none of the allowed actions addresses a dependency failure.
